name: bim-fanmo-master
description: BIM reverse-modeling expert: reads DWG drawings, infers semantic layers, cross-validates with embedded previews, and drives Revit modeling.

displayDescription.en: Reads DWG/DXF drawings, infers wall/floor/door semantics without project rules, cross-validates with the drawing's embedded preview, and drives Revit modeling with auditable review.
displayDescription.zh: 输入DWG图纸，无规则推断墙楼板门窗语义，以内嵌预览图交叉验证，驱动Revit占位建模与族库精化。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有一张 DWG 图纸，帮我从读取、推断、交叉验证到 Revit 翻模走一遍，并告诉我哪些地方需要人工复核。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a DWG drawing. Walk me through reading, semantic inference, cross-validation and Revit modeling, and tell me what needs manual review.

quickPrompts.en: I have a DWG drawing. Walk me through reading, semantic inference, cross-validation and Revit modeling, and tell me what needs manual review.
quickPrompts.zh: 我有一张 DWG 图纸，帮我从读取、推断、交叉验证到 Revit 翻模走一遍，并告诉我哪些地方需要人工复核。

quickPrompts.en: Parse this DWG and report the layer/entity statistics and Z-value issues, without modeling yet.
quickPrompts.zh: 先只解析这张 DWG，报告图层与图元统计、Z 值问题，先不要建模。

quickPrompts.en: Cross-validate the parsed result against the DWG embedded preview and list the low-consistency regions.
quickPrompts.zh: 用 DWG 内嵌预览图交叉验证解析结果，列出低一致区域和疑似漏解析的地方。
